title: Is Bone Stronger Than Steel?
description:
You have probably heard that bone is stronger than steel. Is that actually true?

Steel is generally stronger in absolute terms, but bone has an impressive strength-to-weight ratio and is a living, self-repairing composite.

The comparison depends on tension, compression, specimen direction and whether strength is normalised by mass or density.

Bone combines stiffness, toughness, low weight and biological repair—properties a simple steel bar does not share.
